scope: Host-level licensing research for every catalog source host, plus the YouTube video link. Not article-by-article legal clearance, a plagiarism audit, or a legal opinion.

hosts.uses: Kit descriptions, awakening, rotations and protection references.
hosts.finding: The specific MCOC wiki indexed footer identifies CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted. Fandom describes a default 3.0 license. Direct Doctor Doom fetch failed; each article exception and revision remains unchecked.
hosts.requiredAction: Classify actual reuse as facts versus adapted expression. For adaptations, verify exact article license/version and exceptions; supply attribution, license link, change notice and applicable share-alike licensing. Do not assume this licenses game artwork or copied third-party text.

hosts.uses: Raw ability/protection lists and relic suggestions across all333 referenceFacts, plus kit references.
hosts.finding: Homepage returned no readable terms; targeted policy searches did not establish a commercial data-reuse grant.
hosts.requiredAction: Obtain permission covering the intended ad-supported use and extent of data reuse, or independently rebuild/remove source-derived catalog material. Assess compilation rights; attribution alone is insufficient.

hosts.finding: About identifies upstream Fandom CC-BY-SA metadata and MCOCHUB data. Its stated MIT license covers code; no blanket independent data grant was established.
hosts.requiredAction: Trace upstream rights for the actual champion material. Satisfy applicable Fandom terms and obtain necessary upstream permissions or replace affected content. Do not apply the code license to data.

hosts.finding: Same service as www.mcoc.help; upstream data rights remain material.
hosts.requiredAction: Apply the same upstream rights review as www.mcoc.help.

hosts.uses: Three new champion kit references, also an upstream supplier identified by mcoc.help.
hosts.finding: Terms reserve the site compilation. API documentation offers access by request and requires credit; no blanket commercial grant was found.
hosts.requiredAction: Request written scope covering ad-supported use, derived guides and any redistribution before relying on its compilation. Do not assume existing links or public API documentation provide permission.

hosts.finding: Homepage is JavaScript-only in the research tool; no reuse license was established.
hosts.requiredAction: Verify terms and classify factual versus expressive reuse; obtain permission or replace uncertain material.

hosts.finding: Same service as www.auntm.ai; no commercial reuse grant established.
hosts.requiredAction: Apply the same review as www.auntm.ai.

hosts.uses: One community counter report referenced by kushala-serpent.
hosts.finding: Reddit terms leave users their ownership rights; a license granted to Reddit does not automatically license this site.
hosts.requiredAction: Retain link and independently supported factual analysis; inspect actual text overlap. Obtain author permission or a documented applicable exception for any protected expression reused.

hosts.uses: Official system announcements and player discussions supporting counter/focus guidance.
hosts.finding: Official announcements and player posts have different authors. No blanket redistribution license was established; Kabam terms endpoint yielded no readable text.
hosts.requiredAction: Distinguish official facts from member expression and reproduced game text. Verify current applicable terms and document permission or legal basis; keep attribution.

hosts.uses: Official news index and two champion spotlights.
hosts.finding: Official publication supports provenance, not a general commercial reuse license. Current Kabam terms could not be read by this tool.
hosts.requiredAction: Use independently written factual reporting after rights review. Obtain authorization for protected assets/text if needed; verify current fan-content/commercial policy with the rights holder or counsel.

hosts.finding: Site exposes an Aviso legal button but its contents were not available in the text fetch. No reuse license established.
hosts.requiredAction: Read the legal notice interactively or obtain the operator terms; review boss summaries for protected expression and seek permission or replace uncertain text.

additionalMedia.uses: Outbound creator video link; no video download or rehosting found in catalog.
additionalMedia.requiredAction: Keep attribution and original outbound link. If adding embeds, use the supported player and review YouTube advertising restrictions; do not make YouTube content the primary basis for ad sales.

principles.note: US copyright distinguishes facts/systems from protected expression. This is not jurisdiction-independent permission for bulk reuse.
Qualifying EU databases can have rights against extraction/reuse of substantial contents. Applicability requires case-specific assessment.

limitations: No permission requests were sent and no licenses accepted.
No rights-holder approval or legal opinion obtained.
No current Kabam blanket commercial fan-site permission established.
Fandom exact revisions, article exceptions, and adapted-text licensing are not resolved.
A source link, robots allowance, absence of readable terms, or another site running ads does not establish reuse permission.
Underlying Marvel/Kabam protected game text, artwork and trademark questions remain separate from community text licenses.
